# Annual Leave Policy

## 1. Entitlement

All permanent employees accrue annual leave from their date of joining.
The standard entitlement is 21 working days per fiscal year. Employees at
senior job grades receive an enhanced entitlement as set out in their grade
band; the figure recorded against the employee's grade in the HR system is
authoritative.

## 2. Accrual

Leave accrues monthly in arrears. An employee who joins part-way through the
fiscal year accrues a pro-rata entitlement for that year.

## 3. Notice and approval

Requests must be submitted at least 5 working days before the intended start
date. Absences longer than 10 consecutive working days require approval from
the department head in addition to the line manager.

## 4. Carry-forward

Up to 5 unused days may be carried into the following fiscal year. Days beyond
that ceiling lapse on the last day of the fiscal year and are not paid out.

## 5. Minimum service

Employees may not take annual leave during their first 3 months of service
except in circumstances covered by the Emergency Leave Policy.
